'''Smooth Red Sandstone''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Smooth Red Sandstone Slab}}) and a [[Mud Kiln]] recipe (from [[Red Sandstone]]). See {{MCW|Smooth Red Sandstone}} for everything else.
